saints.name: St. Cuthbert
saints.title: Bishop of Lindisfarne
saints.shortBlurb: The shepherd turned monk of Lindisfarne, beloved wonderworker of Northumbria and lover of solitude…
biography: Born about 634 in the Scottish borders, Cuthbert entered the monastery of Melrose and later became prior of Lindisfarne. A tireless missionary among the people of Northumbria, he was also a man of deep prayer who withdrew for years to the solitude of the island of Inner Farne.

Made bishop of Lindisfarne in 685, he served only briefly before his death in 687. His holiness, his reported miracles, and the later discovery of his incorrupt body made his shrine, now at Durham, one of the great centers of English devotion; his life was written by St. Bede.
saints.knownFor: His missionary charity and holiness in Northumbria.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 20 March
